Moor Hall Restaurant
====================

Site: https://moorhallrestaurant.com

Description:
Moor Hall Restaurant offers authentic culinary experiences with specialty coffee,
fresh bakery, and tailored catering for memorable events in Kigali, Rwanda.

-------
Provide public information about dining, menus, services, gallery, restaurant
information, and contact details.
